# requires: wire
#
# A single range answered as `multipart/byteranges`. RFC 9110 allows it and a
# proxy coalescing requests produces it, and its body is MIME: a boundary line,
# per-part headers, a blank line, then the bytes. Appended without being parsed,
# the artifact gets the boundary written into the middle of it.
submit A size=64 digest=good src=http:multipart
claim A alpha 5000
stage A 40
progress A alpha 40 {"verified_prefix":40}
release A alpha
run A beta
orphans
state A

# expect 6: ok state=transferred [DL-R8]
# expect 6: done=64 err=none
# expect 7: ok -
